title: Scalable Suppliers in Global Trade Networks
title_zh: 全球贸易网络中的可扩展供应商
title_primary: 全球贸易网络中的可扩展供应商
title_secondary: Scalable Suppliers in Global Trade Networks
authors: Brandon Joel Tan
official: 官方在线 2026-08-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Whether exporters can take advantage of increases in foreign demand depends on the scalability of their input suppliers—that is, suppliers’ ability to expand production when demand rises. Using bilateral trade data linked to international input-output tables, I measure supplier scalability at the country-industry level and examine how it shapes downstream export growth. I find that supplier scalability varies sharply across industries within countries, that scalable suppliers tend to be connected to scalable suppliers themselves, and that downstream country-sectors exposed to more scalable suppliers respond more strongly to positive foreign demand shocks in sectors with relationship-sticky inputs. I rationalize these facts in a multicountry, multi-sector general-equilibrium trade model with input-output linkages, heterogeneous upward-sloping supplier supply curves, and gradually adjusting sourcing relationships. In the calibrated model, supplier bottlenecks substantially attenuate the export and welfare gains from a global demand expansion, while relationship stickiness determines where bottlenecks bind. Counterfactuals show that supplier upgrading and pre-arranged access to flexible sourcing networks are most valuable when targeted toward economically central, relationship-sticky, and bottleneck-exposed parts of the production network.
abstract_zh: 出口商能否利用外国需求的增长，取决于其投入品供应商的可扩展性——即供应商在需求上升时扩大生产的能力。通过将双边贸易数据与国际投入产出表相结合，我在国家-行业层面衡量了供应商的可扩展性，并考察其如何影响下游出口增长。研究发现，供应商可扩展性在国家内部各行业间差异显著，可扩展的供应商往往与其他可扩展供应商相互关联，且下游国家-部门若接触更多可扩展供应商，则在涉及关系粘性投入品的行业中，对正向外国需求冲击的反应更为强烈。我将这些事实纳入一个包含投入产出联系、异质性向上倾斜的供应商供给曲线以及逐步调整的采购关系的多国、多部门一般均衡贸易模型中加以解释。在校准模型中，供应商瓶颈显著削弱了全球需求扩张带来的出口与福利收益，而关系粘性则决定了瓶颈在何处产生约束。反事实分析表明，当供应商升级及预先安排灵活采购网络的可及性被定向于生产网络中经济核心、关系粘性且面临瓶颈暴露的部分时，其价值最为显著。

title: Competing creditor claims and loan recoverability: evidence from anti-recharacterization laws
title_zh: 竞争性债权人索赔与贷款可回收性：来自反重定性法律的证据
title_primary: 竞争性债权人索赔与贷款可回收性：来自反重定性法律的证据
title_secondary: Competing creditor claims and loan recoverability: evidence from anti-recharacterization laws
authors: Walid Saffar, Yuan Sun, Janus Jian Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Anti-recharacterization laws significantly increase the rights of securitization creditors by allowing the buyers of securitized assets to exclusively and immediately seize collateral in bankruptcy. However, strengthening the rights of securitization creditors can limit other creditors’ ability to recover loans. We find that, after a state adopts an anti-recharacterization law, local banks operating in the same state accrue more loan loss provisions, tighten their loan contracts, and incur higher future loan charge-offs. These findings are consistent with the argument that a safe harbor for securitization transactions advantages Wall Street-style structured finance at the expense of Main Street-style lending.
abstract_zh: 反再定性法律通过允许证券化资产的买方在破产中独占并立即取得抵押品，显著增强了证券化债权人的权利。然而，强化证券化债权人的权利可能会限制其他债权人收回贷款的能力。我们发现，在某一州采纳反再定性法律后，该州运营的本地银行计提了更多的贷款损失准备金，收紧了贷款合同，并面临更高的未来贷款核销。这些发现与以下论点一致：证券化交易的安全港规则有利于华尔街式结构化融资，却以牺牲主街式贷款为代价。

title: Currency Dominance Is Not Forever: Some Insights from a Non-Linear Dynamic Model
title_zh: 货币主导地位并非永恒：来自非线性动态模型的一些启示
title_primary: 货币主导地位并非永恒：来自非线性动态模型的一些启示
title_secondary: Currency Dominance Is Not Forever: Some Insights from a Non-Linear Dynamic Model
authors: Michael D. Bordo, Cécile Bastidon
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop stress tests based on an original International Monetary System (IMS) model with regime switchings. The model is calibrated for nine reference currencies from the beginning of the Classical Gold Standard to the present. Regime switchings in currency dominance are related to combinations of conditions on a multidimensional environment variable that includes five classes of shocks: technology; development; monetary, financial and fiscal institutions; democracy and conflicts; and the regulatory environment. We provide an original database of events for these five classes of shocks, which is used for calibration. The calibration highlights the important role of the democracy and conflicts component in regime switchings. The calibrated model is then used to perform stress tests on the current prospects of currency dominance for a broad set of scenarios. A salient result from the scenarios we tested is that the dominance of the US dollar is at most marginally affected. No other currency emerges as a major player, suggesting strong inertia in the system’s current centripetal dynamics.
abstract_zh: 我们基于一个包含制度切换的原创国际货币体系（IMS）模型开发了压力测试。该模型针对从古典金本位制初期至今的九种参考货币进行了校准。货币主导地位中的制度切换与一个多维环境变量的条件组合相关，该变量涵盖五类冲击：技术；发展；货币、金融和财政制度；民主与冲突；以及监管环境。我们为这五类冲击提供了一个原创的事件数据库，用于校准。校准结果凸显了民主与冲突成分在制度切换中的重要作用。随后，校准后的模型被用于对广泛情景下当前货币主导地位前景进行压力测试。我们测试的情景中一个显著结果是，美元的主导地位至多受到轻微影响。没有其他货币成为主要参与者，这表明系统当前向心动态中存在强烈的惯性。

title: Idea Rents and Firm Growth
title_zh: 创意租金与企业成长
title_primary: 创意租金与企业成长
title_secondary: Idea Rents and Firm Growth
authors: Timo Boppart, Peter J. Klenow, Reiko Laski, Huiyu Li
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Which firms drive aggregate productivity growth? We document that firms with high price-earnings ratios tend to see increases in their subsequent earnings relative to sales, which we interpret as rents from ideas (innovation). We construct an endogenous growth model with shocks to firm innovation step-sizes and R&D efficiency and calibrate it to match patterns in the data. The model implies that growth would be much lower, even with the same innovative effort, if firms had the same step sizes. The model can be used to infer expected growth contributions of individual firms (such as members of the Magnificent Seven). We find that the share of growth coming from smaller listed firms substantially exceeds their sales share, whereas the largest listed firms account for less than their sales share.
abstract_zh: 哪些企业推动了总体生产率增长？我们记录到，市盈率较高的企业，其后续盈利相对于销售额往往有所增长，我们将此解读为来自创意的租金（即创新）。我们构建了一个内生增长模型，其中包含企业创新步长和研发效率的冲击，并对其进行校准以匹配数据中的模式。模型表明，即使创新努力相同，若企业步长相同，增长将大幅降低。该模型可用于推断个别企业（如“七巨头”成员）的预期增长贡献。我们发现，来自较小上市企业的增长份额显著超过其销售份额，而最大上市企业的增长贡献则低于其销售份额。

title: Embracing the Enemy
title_zh: 拥抱敌人
title_primary: 拥抱敌人
title_secondary: Embracing the Enemy
authors: Alvaro Delgado-Vega, Johannes Schneider
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: A principal (such as a centrist political party) can partially influence the allocation of power between two competing parties. The principal is closer to one party, the ``Friend'', than to the other, the ``Enemy''. The principal's optimal contract initially seeks to exclude the Enemy. However, once the Enemy gains power, the principal embraces him in exchange for policy moderation. Moderation also disciplines the Friend, inducing him to move closer to the principal's preferred policy. Principals close to the Friend fully embrace the Enemy; more centrist principals divide their support. Commitment benefits the principal only if she is close to the Friend and parties value power little.
abstract_zh: 委托人（如中间派政党）能在一定程度上影响两个竞争政党之间的权力分配。委托人更倾向于其中一方，即“友党”，而非另一方，即“敌党”。委托人的最优契约起初旨在排除敌党。然而，一旦敌党掌权，委托人便接纳其以换取政策上的温和化。

title: DP38 Customs Union, Tariff Reform and Trade in Differentiated Products
title_zh: 关税同盟、关税改革与差异化产品贸易
title_primary: 关税同盟、关税改革与差异化产品贸易
title_secondary: DP38 Customs Union, Tariff Reform and Trade in Differentiated Products
authors: Anthony Venables, Barthelemy Bonadio, Andrei Levchenko, Nitya Pandalai-Nayar, Pierre-Olivier Gourinchas 等
official: 官方在线 1985-01-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The paper analyses tax and tariff policy for trade between economies which each contain a monopolistically competitive industry producing differentiated products. The consequences of tax changes by a single country are examined, and the general desirability of taxing imports more heavily than domestically produced goods is established. Customs union theory is analysed by studying coordinated tax changes by a group of countries; circumstances under which customs union formation and enlargement will benefit members are found. Game theoretic techniques are used to investigate which countries will coalesce into a customs union.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了各经济体均包含一个生产差异化产品的垄断竞争行业时的税收与关税政策。研究考察了单一国家税收变动的后果，并确立了进口商品税负高于国内生产商品的普遍合理性。通过研究一组国家协调税收变动，分析了关税同盟理论；发现了关税同盟形成与扩大将使成员国受益的条件。运用博弈论方法探究了哪些国家会联合形成关税同盟。

title: Effects of oil price uncertainty on the stock returns of oil and gas companies
title_zh: 油价不确定性对油气公司股票收益的影响
title_primary: 油价不确定性对油气公司股票收益的影响
title_secondary: Effects of oil price uncertainty on the stock returns of oil and gas companies
authors: Elena Maria Diaz, J. Cuñado, F. P. de Gracia
official: 官方在线 2026-07-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper investigates the distinct effects of oil-specific and global uncertainty shocks on the stock returns of international oil and gas companies. Using monthly data from May 2007 to August 2025, we employ a Dynamic Factor Model on high-frequency volatility indices to construct separate proxies for global uncertainty and idiosyncratic oil uncertainty shocks. The dynamic effects of these shocks are estimated using Smoothed Local Projections. Global uncertainty shocks generate an immediate and homogeneous decline in stock returns across integrated, upstream, and downstream firms. In contrast, the effects of oil-specific uncertainty depend on a firm’s position within the value chain. Upstream firms exhibit the most pronounced responses, integrated firms display intermediate and mixed effects, while downstream companies appear comparatively insulated from oil-market uncertainty. These findings highlight the importance of distinguishing global from sector-specific uncertainty when assessing the financial consequences of uncertainty shocks in energy markets.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了石油特定冲击与全球不确定性冲击对国际油气公司股票收益的差异化影响。利用2007年5月至2025年8月的月度数据，我们采用动态因子模型对高频波动率指数进行分析，构建了全球不确定性与特质性石油不确定性冲击的独立代理变量。通过平滑局部投影法估计这些冲击的动态效应。全球不确定性冲击导致综合、上游及下游企业的股票收益立即且同质性地下降。相比之下，石油特定不确定性的影响则取决于企业在价值链中的位置。上游企业表现出最显著的反应，综合企业呈现中间且混合的效果，而下游公司则相对免受石油市场不确定性的影响。这些发现强调了在评估能源市场不确定性冲击的财务后果时，区分全球性与部门特定不确定性的重要性。

title: Does industrial land bias crowd out social public services? Evidence from China
title_zh: 工业用地偏向是否挤出了社会公共服务？来自中国的证据
title_primary: 工业用地偏向是否挤出了社会公共服务？来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Does industrial land bias crowd out social public services? Evidence from China
authors: Zekun Fan, Zhihao He, Weidong Qu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines whether industrial land bias in China’s land-supply policy crowds out social public services. Using prefecture-level panel data spanning 2002–2022, we construct an Industrial Land Bias Index (ILBI) and a City Public Service Index (CPSI) to analyze the relationship between growth-oriented land allocation and public service composition. We document a robust structural crowding-out effect: a one-standard-deviation increase in industrial land bias corresponds to a 0.32 %age-point decline in the share of social services (education, healthcare, social security and welfare, and culture and sports) within total public service capacity. Decomposition analysis reveals that this effect operates primarily through price concessions rather than quantity allocation. The crowding-out relationship is stronger in more market-oriented land-transfer environments, consistent with price discounts providing clearer signals of pro-industry commitment. The effect is most pronounced among cities with high fiscal self-sufficiency and among those with more service-oriented economies. These findings expose hidden opportunity costs of China’s “land-for-growth” model and offer policy implications for rebalancing urban public service provision.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了中国土地供应政策中的工业用地偏向是否挤出了社会公共服务。利用2002—2022年地级市面板数据，我们构建了工业用地偏向指数（ILBI）与城市公共服务指数（CPSI），以分析增长导向的土地配置与公共服务结构之间的关系。我们发现了稳健的结构性挤出效应：工业用地偏向每增加一个标准差，社会服务（教育、医疗卫生、社会保障与福利、文化体育）在公共服务总能力中的占比将下降0.32个百分点。分解分析表明，该效应主要通过价格让渡而非数量配置发挥作用。在市场化程度更高的土地出让环境中，挤出关系更为显著，这与价格折扣为亲工业承诺提供更清晰信号的事实相一致。该效应在财政自给率较高的城市以及服务业导向更强的城市中最为突出。这些发现揭示了“以地谋增长”模式中隐含的机会成本，并为重新平衡城市公共服务供给提供了政策启示。

title: DP151 Macroeconomic Policy Design with Incomplete Information: A New Argument for Coordinating Economic Policies
title_zh: 不完全信息下的宏观经济政策设计：协调经济政策的新论据
title_primary: 不完全信息下的宏观经济政策设计：协调经济政策的新论据
title_secondary: DP151 Macroeconomic Policy Design with Incomplete Information: A New Argument for Coordinating Economic Policies
authors: Andrew Hughes Hallett
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The harshest criticism of econometrically based policy evaluation is undoubtedly the sensitivity of its conclusions to assumptions concerning the information available to policy-makers or to misspecification of the econometric models used in the evaluation. Economists appear to have accepted this criticism without examining how far it is justified and to what extent it can be overcome. These sensitivities can be broadly classified into those due to information errors (non-controllable shocks external to the economy, as modelled) and those due to modelling errors (errors caused by differences between the true structure of the economy and the specification of the econometric model). This paper considers the former case and studies the sensitivity of macroeconomic policy design to information errors in a multicountry setting. It argues that a policy regime of cooperation produces more robust policy designs than does non-cooperative policy-making, particularly when policy-makers exploit their freedom to revise their decisions in the light of past errors. The investigation involves some theoretical analysis and numerical sensitivity analysis using two different empirical models (extending work done earlier with Andries Brandsma) and complements a study by Hughes Hallett and Holtham on robustness and model errors (presented at an International Economic Association conference, organized by CEPR on Global Macroeconomics: Policy Conflict and Cooperation, February 1987).
abstract_zh: 对基于计量经济学的政策评估最严厉的批评，莫过于其结论对政策制定者信息可得性假设的敏感性，或对评估所用计量经济模型设定错误的敏感性。经济学家似乎在不加审视这种批评的合理性及其可克服程度的情况下，便接受了这一观点。这些敏感性可大致分为两类：信息误差（模型化经济体系外部不可控冲击所致）与建模误差（经济真实结构与计量模型设定差异所致）。本文聚焦前者，在多国框架下研究宏观经济政策设计对信息误差的敏感性。研究表明，合作型政策体制比非合作型决策能产生更稳健的政策设计，尤其当政策制定者利用自由裁量权根据既往错误修正决策时。本研究通过两个不同实证模型（延续与Andries Brandsma的早期合作研究）进行理论分析与数值敏感性检验，并补充了Hughes Hallett与Holtham关于稳健性与模型误差的研究（该研究于1987年2月由CEPR组织的国际经济学协会"全球宏观经济学：政策冲突与合作"会议上发表）。

title: DP8176 Anticipated Alternative Instrument-Rate Paths in Policy Simulations
title_zh: 政策模拟中预期的替代性利率路径
title_primary: 政策模拟中预期的替代性利率路径
title_secondary: DP8176 Anticipated Alternative Instrument-Rate Paths in Policy Simulations
authors: Lars E.O. Svensson, Stefan Laseen
official: 官方在线 2011-01-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper specifies a new convenient algorithm to construct policy projections conditional on alternative anticipated policy-rate paths in linearized dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) models, such as Ramses, the Riksbank's main DSGE model. Such projections with anticipated policy-rate paths correspond to situations where the central bank transparently announces that it, conditional on current information, plans to implement a particular policy-rate path and where this announced plan for the policy rate is believed and then anticipated by the private sector. The main idea of the algorithm is to include among the predetermined variables (the 'state' of the economy) the vector of nonzero means of future shocks to a given policy rule that is required to satisfy the given anticipated policy-rate path.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的便捷算法，用于在线性化动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型（如瑞典央行的主要DSGE模型Ramses）中，构建基于替代性预期政策利率路径的政策预测。此类包含预期政策利率路径的预测，对应于中央银行在现有信息条件下透明地宣布其计划实施特定政策利率路径，且该宣布的政策利率计划被私人部门相信并预期的情况。该算法的核心思想是，在预定变量（即经济“状态”）中纳入未来对给定政策规则冲击的非零均值向量，该向量需满足给定的预期政策利率路径。

title: Disruption and Displacement in Health Care: Evidence from Nursing Home Closures
title_zh: 医疗保健中的中断与替代：来自养老院关闭的证据
title_primary: 医疗保健中的中断与替代：来自养老院关闭的证据
title_secondary: Disruption and Displacement in Health Care: Evidence from Nursing Home Closures
authors: Olenski, Andrew
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines the impacts of health care provider exits on patient outcomes and displacement. Leveraging data on the universe of long-stay nursing home patients, I estimate the mortality effects of 1,104 nursing home closures using a difference-in-differences approach. Displaced residents face a substantial short-run increase in mortality, with this disruption effect strongest among older and frailer patients. However, surviving patients tend to transfer to higher-quality providers. I find suggestive evidence that for certain subgroups this reallocation may lead to improved long-term survival, net of the initial disruption effect. The findings highlight the immediate health risks of displacement and the potential for quality-driven reallocation to mitigate them. *
abstract_zh: 本文研究了医疗服务提供者退出对患者结局与转移的影响。利用长期护理机构住院患者的全样本数据，我采用双重差分法估算了1104家养老院关闭对死亡率的影响。被转移的居民在短期内面临显著的死亡率上升，这种中断效应在年长及体弱患者中最为强烈。然而，幸存患者倾向于转入更高质量的护理机构。我发现了提示性证据：对于某些亚群体而言，这种重新配置可能带来长期生存率的改善，抵消了初始中断效应的影响。研究结果凸显了患者转移的即时健康风险，以及以质量为导向的重新配置在缓解这些风险方面的潜力。

title: Compatibility and investment incentives in dynamic procurement
title_zh: 动态采购中的兼容性与投资激励
title_primary: 动态采购中的兼容性与投资激励
title_secondary: Compatibility and investment incentives in dynamic procurement
authors: Makoto Hanazono, Susumu Sato
official: 官方在线 2026-07-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study compatibility design in repeated procurement. A winning supplier can make a cost-reducing investment that carries over, while compatibility determines how much of the cost reduction is usable by the alternative supplier. Greater compatibility strengthens the alternative supplier but lowers the future value of winning and can weaken investment incentives. We show that when investment is sustainable, optimal compatibility is the lower of the unconstrained buyer-surplus optimum and the investment-sustaining ceiling. Except when zero compatibility is always optimal, buyer-optimal compatibility first rises and then falls with supplier patience.
abstract_zh: 我们研究重复采购中的兼容性设计。获胜供应商可以进行具有延续性的成本削减投资，而兼容性决定了替代供应商能够利用多少成本削减成果。更高的兼容性会增强替代供应商的实力，但会降低未来获胜的价值，并可能削弱投资激励。研究表明，当投资具有可持续性时，最优兼容性取无约束买方剩余最优值与投资可持续上限两者中的较低值。除非零兼容性始终为最优方案，否则买方最优兼容性会随供应商耐心程度先升后降。

title: Job Ads as Signals: Evidence from a Priced Amenity and Worker Beliefs
title_zh: 职位广告作为信号：来自定价福利与工人信念的证据
title_primary: 职位广告作为信号：来自定价福利与工人信念的证据
title_secondary: Job Ads as Signals: Evidence from a Priced Amenity and Worker Beliefs
authors: Simon Jäger, Pawel Pawel Adrjan, Mária Balgová, Jonas Jessen, Jason Sockin
official: 官方在线 2026-07-04 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Discrete choice experiments are widely used to estimate workers' willingness to pay (WTP) for job amenities under the assumption that varying an attribute does not change workers' beliefs about other job attributes. We test this assumption by embedding an amenity with a known market price, a popular monthly public transport pass, in a large-scale discrete choice experiment with German workers. Many workers, including public transport users, overvalue the ticket by more than 100%, despite WTP for other attributes aligning with the literature. A complementary belief-elicitation experiment shows that advertising an amenity, such as the pass but also common amenities like work from home, causally shifts beliefs about unlisted attributes of the job. Posted wages similarly signal unlisted attributes so that wage variation, the money metric for WTP calculation, is itself contaminated by belief spillovers---such as higher pay signaling heightened stress. These spillovers imply that discrete choice estimates capture perceived bundles rather than isolated attributes, and distort current estimates of non-wage compensation and monopsony power.
abstract_zh: 离散选择实验被广泛用于估算工人对工作福利的支付意愿，其前提假设是改变某一属性不会改变工人对其他工作属性的信念。我们通过将一项具有已知市场价格的工作福利——德国广受欢迎的月度公共交通通票——嵌入一项针对德国工人的大规模离散选择实验来检验这一假设。许多工人（包括公共交通使用者）对该通票的估值高出实际价格100%以上，尽管对其他属性的支付意愿与现有文献一致。一项补充性的信念诱导实验表明，宣传某项工作福利（如通票，以及居家办公等常见福利）会因果性地改变工人对工作未列明属性的信念。公布的工资同样会传递未列明属性的信号，因此作为支付意愿计算货币度量的工资变动本身也受到信念溢出效应的影响——例如，高薪可能意味着更高的工作压力。这些溢出效应意味着离散选择实验的估计值反映的是工人感知到的福利组合，而非孤立的属性，并扭曲了当前对非工资补偿和买方垄断势力的估算。

title: How institutional rule erosion shapes land use trajectories at forest margins in upland Indonesia
title_zh: 制度规则侵蚀如何塑造印度尼西亚高地森林边缘的土地利用轨迹
title_primary: 制度规则侵蚀如何塑造印度尼西亚高地森林边缘的土地利用轨迹
title_secondary: How institutional rule erosion shapes land use trajectories at forest margins in upland Indonesia
authors: Naufal Naufal, Jon C. Lovett, Victoria Houlden, Steve Carver
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Maladaptive land use change at forest margins presents a persistent governance challenge under climate and policy pressures. This paper introduces the concept of rule erosion to explain how the gradual and uneven weakening of institutional rules drives land use change. While institutional analyses have treated rule change as adaptive flexibility or as macro-level drift, the cumulative weakening of operational rules-in-use at the community level remains under-theorised. Drawing on the Upland Saddang watershed, Indonesia, we examine how the weakening of boundary, scope and payoff rules within multi-level governance has shaped farmers' decisions and narrowed adaptation pathways. The two study villages were selected from those in the watershed that were identified as experiencing persistent drought. In the two villages data was gathered from 35 farmer interviews covering 129 land plots, 10 stakeholder interviews, focus group discussions and participatory GIS. Using the Institutional Analysis and Development (IAD) framework, these findings show that maize cultivation (62.6% of plots) has become the dominant outcome across a wide range of former land uses—converting from paddy, cocoa, forest and grasslands—a pattern closely linked to repeated cycles of maize seed assistance rather than autonomous adaptation. Weakened boundary rules made maize seed assistance effectively open-access; loose scope rules have pushed it onto steep slopes and forest margins; and payoff rules have favoured short-cycle returns, narrowing available options and creating the conditions for what we term assistance-led maladaptation. The analysis extends the concept of erosion from constitutional and international-norms scholarship to community-level resource governance and calls for graduated multi-level safeguards that preserve local adaptive flexibility.
abstract_zh: 森林边缘的适应性不良土地利用变化在气候与政策压力下构成了持续性的治理挑战。本文引入规则侵蚀概念，阐释制度规则渐进且不均衡的弱化如何驱动土地利用变化。尽管制度分析将规则变化视为适应性弹性或宏观层面的漂移，但社区层面操作性使用规则的累积性弱化仍缺乏理论化探讨。以印度尼西亚高地萨达河流域为案例，我们考察了多层级治理中边界规则、范围规则与收益规则的弱化如何影响农户决策并收窄适应路径。两个研究村庄选自流域内持续干旱区域，通过35份农户访谈（覆盖129块土地）、10份利益相关者访谈、焦点小组讨论及参与式地理信息系统收集数据。运用制度分析与发展（IAD）框架的研究表明，玉米种植（占土地样本62.6%）已成为各类前土地利用类型（包括稻田、可可林、森林与草地）转型后的主导结果——这一模式与玉米种子援助的周期性循环密切相关，而非自主适应行为。弱化的边界规则使玉米种子援助实质上成为开放获取资源；松散的范畴规则将其推向陡坡与森林边缘；收益规则则偏向短周期回报，收窄了可用选择空间，形成了我们称之为援助导向型适应不良的条件。该分析将规则侵蚀概念从宪法与国际规范研究领域拓展至社区层面资源治理，并呼吁建立保留地方适应灵活性的渐进式多层保障机制。

title: Mutual Fund Flows at Long Horizons
title_zh: 长期视角下的共同基金资金流动
title_primary: 长期视角下的共同基金资金流动
title_secondary: Mutual Fund Flows at Long Horizons
authors: Hendrik Bessembinder, Shuaiyu Chen, Michael J Cooper, Jinming Xue, Feng Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We show that positive flows to active mutual funds with high recent returns partially reverse at longer horizons. This outcome is robust across a broad range of alternative specifications. Reversal occurs from greater outflows associated with high prior returns, not reduced inflows. We test theories to explain the reversal: investment life cycles, tax loss selling, and a behavioral “disappointment” hypothesis based on investors’ overreaction to positive returns. While both tax loss selling and short investor life cycles can contribute, the evidence supports a role for investor disappointment, whereby investors redeem their capital when return performance fails to meet expectations. (JEL G10, G23)
abstract_zh: 摘要 我们证明，近期回报率较高的主动型共同基金的正向资金流入在较长时期内会出现部分逆转。这一结果在多种替代性设定下均保持稳健。逆转源于高前期回报带来的更大规模资金流出，而非流入减少。我们检验了三种解释逆转的理论：投资生命周期、税收损失出售以及基于投资者对正回报过度反应的行为"失望"假说。尽管税收损失出售和较短的投资生命周期均可能发挥作用，但证据支持投资者失望假说的作用，即当回报表现未达预期时，投资者会赎回其资本。（JEL G10, G23）

title: The Hidden Cost of Firearm Violence on Infants in Utero
title_zh: 枪支暴力对胎儿期婴儿的隐性成本
title_primary: 枪支暴力对胎儿期婴儿的隐性成本
title_secondary: The Hidden Cost of Firearm Violence on Infants in Utero
authors: Janet Currie, Bahadir Dursun, Michael Hatch, Erdal Tekin
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine the impact of firearm violence on newborn health in the U.S. using two approaches. First, we analyze the “beltway sniper” attacks in 2002, leveraging both temporal and spatial variation to compare birth outcomes of exposed children to those unexposed. Second, we investigate in-utero exposure to mass shootings using national data. We find that exposure to these incidents during pregnancy increases the likelihood of very low-birthweight and very premature birth. These events carry a significant economic burden, with the beltway sniper attacks costing at least $155 million and mass shootings resulting in annual costs exceeding $75 million.
abstract_zh: 本文采用两种方法考察美国枪支暴力对新生儿健康的影响。首先，我们以2002年"环城狙击手"袭击事件为研究对象，利用时间与空间双重变异，比较受暴露儿童与未受暴露儿童的出生结局。其次，我们运用全国数据探究产前接触大规模枪击事件的影响。研究发现，孕期暴露于此类事件会显著增加极低出生体重和极早产的发生概率。这些事件带来沉重的经济负担——"环城狙击手"袭击事件至少造成1.55亿美元损失，而大规模枪击事件每年产生的成本超过7500万美元。

title: Fiscal externalities of transaction taxes: Evidence from the Los Angeles mansion tax
title_zh: 交易税的财政外部性：来自洛杉矶豪宅税的证据
title_primary: 交易税的财政外部性：来自洛杉矶豪宅税的证据
title_secondary: Fiscal externalities of transaction taxes: Evidence from the Los Angeles mansion tax
authors: Daniel Green, Vikram Jambulapati, Jack Liebersohn, Tejaswi Velayudhan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We estimate the fiscal externalities of a property transfer tax, the Los Angeles “Mansion Tax”, on the revenues from property taxes when assessed values are closely tied to transactions. In California, as in over half of U.S. states, growth in tax assessments between transactions lags market values, so any reduction in transaction frequency reduces the growth of property tax revenue. Assuming that Measure ULA did not directly change transaction rates outside of Los Angeles, we estimate a sizable fiscal externality: in our benchmark calibration, the resulting property-tax revenue loss offsets about four-fifths of the revenue generated by the transfer tax, and under alternative parameter values the offset can range from 30 percent to over 100 percent. The net revenue loss is larger for high-value and commercial properties.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了房产转让税（洛杉矶“豪宅税”）对房产税收入产生的财政外部性，前提是评估价值与交易紧密相关。在加利福尼亚州，如同美国超过一半的州一样，交易间隔期间的税收评估增长滞后于市场价值，因此任何交易频率的减少都会降低房产税收入的增长。假设ULA法案并未直接改变洛杉矶以外的交易率，我们估算出一个显著的财政外部性：在我们的基准校准中，由此产生的房产税收入损失抵消了转让税收入的约五分之四，而在其他参数值下，这一抵消比例可从30%到超过100%不等。对于高价值及商业房产，净收入损失更大。

title: Carbon emissions trading markets and low-carbon technology innovation: the perspective of financial geographic structure
title_zh: 碳排放权交易市场与低碳技术创新：金融地理结构的视角
title_primary: 碳排放权交易市场与低碳技术创新：金融地理结构的视角
title_secondary: Carbon emissions trading markets and low-carbon technology innovation: the perspective of financial geographic structure
authors: Haisen Wang, Gangqiang Yang, Gang Li
official: 官方在线 2025-09-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: To assess the impact of China’s Carbon Emissions Trading Market (CETM) on promoting Low-Carbon Technology Innovation (LCTI) within companies, we analyse micro-level corporate data, macro-level city data, and geographic data from 2010 to 2022. We utilize a moderated mediation model within a difference-in-differences framework to explore the relationship between CETM and LCTI. Our findings indicate that CETM significantly fosters LCTI in corporate entities, with a pronounced effect in firms with Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) ratings and those targeted by green investment funds. Additionally, CETM enhances corporate LCTI by facilitating greater access to credit financing, with the availability of credit acting as a moderator. We find that proximity to policy banks enhances the mediating role of credit financing in the relationship between CETM and corporate LCTI, whereas the presence of nearby state-owned banks has a less substantial moderating effect. These findings highlight CETM’s crucial role in advancing LCTI, especially among firms focused on environmental sustainability and supported by green investment funds. Our study sheds light on the complex interplay between CETM, credit financing, and the banking sector, providing insights into how CETM stimulates LCTI.
abstract_zh: 为评估中国碳排放权交易市场（CETM）对企业低碳技术创新（LCTI）的促进作用，我们分析了2010至2022年间的微观企业数据、宏观城市数据及地理数据。在双重差分框架下，我们采用有调节的中介效应模型，探究CETM与LCTI之间的关系。研究发现：CETM显著推动企业LCTI发展，且在具有环境、社会与治理（ESG）评级的企业及绿色投资基金目标企业中效果尤为突出。此外，CETM通过扩大企业信贷融资渠道促进LCTI，其中信贷可得性发挥调节作用。我们发现，靠近政策性银行会强化信贷融资在CETM与企业LCTI关系中的中介效应，而邻近国有商业银行的调节作用相对较弱。这些发现凸显了CETM在推进LCTI中的关键作用，尤其对注重环境可持续性并获绿色投资基金支持的企业而言。本研究揭示了CETM、信贷融资与银行业之间的复杂互动机制，为理解CETM如何激发LCTI提供了新视角。

title: Do subsidy allocation decisions conform to Q theory? Evidence from China
title_zh: 补贴分配决策是否符合Q理论？来自中国的证据
title_primary: 补贴分配决策是否符合Q理论？来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Do subsidy allocation decisions conform to Q theory? Evidence from China
authors: Kebin Deng Zhong Ding Xiaojie Liao Yushu Zhu a School of Economics and Finance, South China University of Technology, Guangzhou, Chinab School of Accounting, Guangdong University of Foreign Studies, Guangzhou, Chinac College of Business 等
official: 官方在线 2025-08-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study investigates the Chinese government’s subsidy allocations to domestic public companies, focusing on the economic versus political motives behind these decisions. Using two-way fixed effects regression models with firm-level annual subsidy data from 2008 to 2023, we find distinct subsidy allocation patterns based on Tobin’s Q values. Firms with Q values above 1 receive subsidies driven by economic motives, with the government favouring those with higher market value efficiency. In contrast, firms with Q values below 1 are more likely to receive subsidies motivated by political considerations, particularly supporting weaker performers. Robustness checks confirm our findings, including two-stage least squares, difference-in-differences regressions with policy shocks, and cross-sectional analyses. Additionally, subsidies allocated to firms with higher Tobin’s Q values enhance their investment efficiency, particularly benefiting non-state-owned enterprises and those operating in market-oriented regions. A regression discontinuity design reveals that subsidies to underperforming state-owned enterprises are politically motivated. This study reconciles inconsistencies in prior research regarding the relationship between investment efficiency and subsidy allocation, providing new insights into government subsidy strategies.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了中国政府对国内上市公司的补贴分配，聚焦于这些决策背后的经济动机与政治动机。利用2008年至2023年企业层面的年度补贴数据，采用双向固定效应回归模型，我们发现基于托宾Q值的不同补贴分配模式。托宾Q值高于1的企业所获补贴受经济动机驱动，政府倾向于支持市场价值效率较高的企业。相反，托宾Q值低于1的企业更可能因政治考量而获得补贴，尤其是对表现较弱者的支持。稳健性检验证实了我们的发现，包括两阶段最小二乘法、基于政策冲击的双重差分回归以及横截面分析。此外，分配给托宾Q值较高企业的补贴提升了其投资效率，尤其惠及非国有企业及位于市场化程度较高地区的企业。断点回归设计揭示，对表现不佳的国有企业的补贴具有政治动机。本研究调和了以往关于投资效率与补贴分配关系研究中的不一致之处，为政府补贴策略提供了新的见解。

title: Alleviating the public’s worries: how social security can enable the upgrading of household consumption
title_zh: 缓解公众忧虑：社会保障如何促进家庭消费升级
title_primary: 缓解公众忧虑：社会保障如何促进家庭消费升级
title_secondary: Alleviating the public’s worries: how social security can enable the upgrading of household consumption
authors: Zeru Wang Chengyou Li Yong Jiao a The Center for Economic Research, Shandong University, Jinan, Chinab School of Finance, Shandong University of Finance and Economics, Jinan, Chinac School of Economics and Management 等
official: 官方在线 2025-08-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Upgrading household consumption is essential for China’s high-quality economic development. This study develops a framework for asset allocation and consumption decision-making that includes wealth accumulation and social security, clarifying the theoretical mechanisms through which social security influences household consumption upgrading. Using a mixed cross-sectional dataset from the Chinese Social Survey (CSS), this study empirically evaluates the impact of social security on household consumption upgrading. The results show that (1) social security significantly and positively affects household consumption upgrading; this result is robust after accounting for endogeneity problems and conducting multiple robustness checks. (2) The impact of social security on household consumption upgrading varies across cultural practices, pandemic shocks, and employment characteristics, showing heterogeneity. (3) Social security can promote household consumption upgrading by enhancing future household expectations. The role of expectations is significant in how social security influences household consumption upgrading.
abstract_zh: 居民消费升级对于中国经济高质量发展至关重要。本研究构建了一个包含财富积累与社会保障的资产配置与消费决策框架，明确了社会保障影响居民消费升级的理论机制。利用中国社会状况综合调查（CSS）的混合截面数据，本研究实证评估了社会保障对居民消费升级的影响。结果显示：（1）社会保障显著正向影响居民消费升级；在考虑内生性问题并进行多项稳健性检验后，这一结果依然稳健。（2）社会保障对居民消费升级的影响因文化习俗、疫情冲击及就业特征的不同而呈现异质性。（3）社会保障能够通过增强居民未来预期来促进消费升级。预期在社会保障影响居民消费升级的过程中发挥着重要作用。

title: Labour at risk
title_zh: 处于风险中的劳动力
title_primary: 处于风险中的劳动力
title_secondary: Labour at risk
authors: Vasco Botelho, Claudia Foroni, Andrea Renzetti, Anri Sakakibara, Kentaro Nakajima 等
official: 官方在线 2023-09-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We propose a Bayesian VAR model with stochastic volatility and time varying skewness to estimate the degree of labour at risk in the euro area and in the United States. We model the asymmetry of the shocks to changes in the unemployment rate as a function of real activity and financial risk factors. We find that the conditional distribution of the changes in the unemployment rate displays time-varying volatility and skewness, with peaks coinciding with the Global Financial Crisis and the COVID-19 pandemic. We take advantage of the multivariate nature of our parametric model to measure stagflation risk defined as the possible joint event of large increases in the unemployment rate and large annual rates of inflation. We find an increasing risk of stagflation for the euro area in 2022 while in the United States stagflation risk increased earlier in 2021 and started decreasing more recently. Notwithstanding the significantly high levels of inflation, stagflation risks have been contained by the resilient performance of the labour market in both areas. Labour at risk is therefore important for the assessment of the inflation-unemployment trade-off.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一个包含随机波动和时变偏度的贝叶斯向量自回归模型，用于估计欧元区和美国的劳动风险程度。我们将失业率变化冲击的非对称性建模为实际经济活动与金融风险因素的函数。研究发现，失业率变化的条件分布呈现时变波动性和偏度特征，其峰值与全球金融危机和新冠疫情时期相吻合。我们利用参数模型的多元特性，将滞胀风险定义为失业率大幅上升与年通胀率高企可能同时发生的联合事件。测算结果显示，欧元区滞胀风险在2022年持续攀升，而美国滞胀风险则更早于2021年上升，近期已开始回落。尽管通胀水平显著高企，但两大经济体的劳动力市场韧性表现有效抑制了滞胀风险。因此，劳动风险对于评估通胀-失业权衡关系具有重要参考价值。
